description: Customer-related intangibles: customer relationships with attrition, distribution networks by channel profitability, and non-compete agreements on protected profits. Method selects the formula. Use for customer relationships, distribution networks, and non-compete assets; customer_relationships projects multi-period revenue with a retention rate. For the workforce and key-person assets use valuation_human_capital; for technology assets use valuation_technology. Per method: customer_relationships needs customer_count + avg_revenue_per_customer + retention_rate + profit_margin + discount_rate + projection_period; distribution_network needs channel_count + revenue_per_channel + channel_margin + useful_life + discount_rate; non_compete needs protected_revenue + profit_margin + term + enforcement_probability + discount_rate; lifetime_value needs revenue_per_period + retention_rate + discount_rate + margin; backlog needs contract_backlog + probability_of_completion + discount_rate; churn_impact needs current_customers + churn_rate_before + churn_rate_after + revenue_per_customer + discount_rate. retention_rate and enforcement_probability are in [0,1]; projection_period sets the number of discounted periods. Only method is required; all other parameters are method-dependent — supply those the selected method names and omit the rest (defaults apply where defined). Rates and premiums are decimals (0.10 = 10%). Pure arithmetic: no I/O and no external calls; values carry the library's own precision (rates are decimals, so a royalty rate of 0.055 is not rounded); parameters belonging to other methods are accepted and ignored. An unknown method, or a missing method-required parameter, returns an error instead of a value.

avg_revenue_per_customer.description: Average annual revenue per customer, in currency units.

channel_margin.description: Channel profit margin as a decimal in [0,1].

churn_rate_after.description: Churn rate after the change, as a decimal (0.10 = 10%).

churn_rate_before.description: Churn rate before the change, as a decimal (0.10 = 10%).

contract_backlog.description: Backlog contracts as JSON objects with `value` and an optional `period` (default 1).

current_customers.description: Number of customers before the change.

discount_rate.description: Per-period discount rate as a decimal (0.10 = 10%).

enforcement_probability.description: Probability the non-compete is enforceable, in [0,1].

margin.description: Profit margin per period, as a decimal (0.20 = 20%).

method.description: Formula to apply. Options: customer_relationships = Multi-period revenue net of attrition, discounted.; distribution_network = Channel revenue times margin over the useful life.; non_compete = Protected profit under an enforcement probability, discounted.; lifetime_value = Customer lifetime value, infinite-horizon form.; backlog = Order backlog as risk-adjusted present value of contracted revenue.; churn_impact = Value impact of a change in the churn rate.

probability_of_completion.description: Probability the backlog is delivered, as a decimal (0.90 = 90%).

protected_revenue.description: Annual revenue protected by the non-compete, in currency units.

revenue_per_channel.description: Annual revenue per channel, in currency units.

revenue_per_customer.description: Revenue per customer per period, in currency units.

revenue_per_period.description: Revenue per customer per period, in currency units.

name: valuation_customer

assumptions.description: Modelling assumptions applied (list of strings or key/value object).

defaults_applied.description: Optional parameters that were not supplied, so their documented defaults were used.

error.description: Error message when the call fails.

method.description: Formula / method name that produced the result.

steps.description: Intermediate calculation steps for traceability (one string per step).
